episodes.synopsis: Reiji Mukudori enters an immersive VRMMO that's more realistic than he thought possible. Luckily, his big brother Shu is there to show him the ropes.
episodes.title: The Beginning of Possibility

episodes.synopsis: Ray takes the perfect job and goes grinding for levels, but winds up geting more than he bargained for. A trip to the Tomb Labyrinth proves fruitful.
episodes.title: Tomb Labyrinth

episodes.synopsis: Ray and friends see how the player killers--most of them--were shut down and eliminated. The party chooses a quest to complete on their way to Gideon.
episodes.title: Superior

episodes.synopsis: The party soon realizes it'll take brains, brawn, and maybe a little something extra to save a group of tians from the Great Miasmic Ogre, Gardranda.
episodes.title: Like a Flag Flying the Reversal

episodes.synopsis: Overhearing a young woman's pleas, Ray winds up taking on a quest with fellow Master Hugo Lesseps to rescue children from a truly distasteful gang.
episodes.title: La Porte de l'Enfer

episodes.synopsis: Ray and Nemesis fight the monster responsble for the zombification of the captured children: Maise, a Lich hell-bent on becoming immortal.
episodes.title: Beyond the Radix Point

episodes.synopsis: Marie invites Ray to Gideon to attend the Clash of the Superiors, an all-out arena battle between two mighty warriors. Figaro and Shu chat in private.
episodes.title: Showdown City

episodes.synopsis: It's Figaro the Endless Chain versus Master Jiangshi Xinyu in a high-speed, no-holds-barred bout--and as it turns out, that's just the opening act.
episodes.title: Clash of the Superiors

episodes.synopsis: It might be up to Ray and his fellow newbies to defend Gideon against Franklin, who's taken a princess hostage and unleashed monsters on the populace.
episodes.title: The Beginning of Madness

episodes.synopsis: Marie finds herself up against a deadly talented Composer and his malevolent musicians, while Franklin reveals a brand-new and highly lethal monster.
episodes.title: The Movement on the Board

episodes.synopsis: Rook goes all-out against Hugo as Ray tackles mad Franklin's RSK, a grotesque creature tailor-made to avenge its creator as Ray's perfect opponent.
episodes.title: The Right Arm of the Victor

episodes.synopsis: The battle against Franklin is far from over as he reveals trick after trick he'd stashed up his sleeve. The King of Destruction comes in with a bang.
episodes.title: King of Destruction

episodes.synopsis: The final battle of Dr. Franklin vs. the rest of Infinite Dendrogram as the finale piece de resistance. And now it's up to Ray and Shu, the Superior Master King of Destruction to finish this once and for all.
episodes.title: Those Who Bind the Possibilities
